fields.name: Yonex Astrox 22 Badminton Racket
fields.description: Yonex Astrox 22 is a lightweight badminton racket weighing approximately 78g (5U), featuring a head-light balance and medium flex shaft for fast swing speed and excellent control. Constructed from high-quality graphite for both frame and shaft, it supports string tension of up to 30 lbs, making it suitable for intermediate to advanced players who prefer quick handling, defensive play, and precise shot placement.

fields.name: Yonex Nanoflare Junior Cyan Badminton Racket
fields.description: Yonex Nanoflare Junior Cyan is a lightweight badminton racket specially designed for junior players and beginners. Featuring a head-light balance and flexible shaft, it offers easy handling, smooth swings, and better control. The durable graphite construction ensures stability and comfort, helping young players develop proper technique and confidence on the court.

fields.name: Victor P8500 NitroLite ZSW/DX Badminton Shoes
fields.description: Victor P8500 NitroLite ZSW/DX Badminton Shoes are designed for high-performance badminton players who demand stability, comfort, and explosive movement on court. Featuring NitroLite cushioning technology, these shoes provide excellent shock absorption and energy return. The reinforced upper and stable sole structure enhance foot support during fast lateral movements, while the non-marking rubber outsole ensures strong grip and durability on indoor courts.

fields.name: Yonex Cascade Drive 3 Badminton Shoes
fields.description: Yonex Cascade Drive 3 Badminton Shoes are designed for players seeking comfort, stability, and smooth movement on the court. With a lightweight construction and supportive cushioning, these shoes help reduce impact during fast footwork. The durable upper provides a secure fit, while the non-marking rubber outsole ensures reliable grip and balance on indoor badminton courts, making them suitable for both training and match play.

This racket is ideal for advanced players who specialize in powerful singles and rear-court doubles play.
